scene: The illustrated map reveals three routes leading far away from Kite Hill.
picture: A flat side view along the wooden hut platform open to the world. Left, a yellow wicker hot-air balloon floats ready. The lanky boy in his orange puffer vest and kite stands centre-left facing right. Centre, a red sleigh tram rests on runners. Far right, a glass-bottomed boat bobs at a wooden gate.
shown: a yellow wicker balloon basket tethered outside the open window on the left
a frost-covered sleigh tram parked by the middle doorway
a bright blue glass-bottomed boat moored at the far right pier gate
